fit.summary: Four years of Python backend work on a billing service with PostgreSQL tuning and on-call; no Kubernetes.

bullets.text: Built a shipment tracking page in React and TypeScript used by 300 customer accounts

cover_letter.hook: Fieldnote Health's payments platform is the kind of system I work on now: Python services where latency and correctness both matter.
cover_letter.body:
At Tallgrass Software I built and maintain a FastAPI billing service that handles 2 million API requests a day, and I cut p95 latency on our invoice endpoint from 900 ms to 180 ms with PostgreSQL indexes and query batching. I also share on-call for 6 services and wrote the runbooks the rotation uses.

Outside work I maintain tidycsv, a Python library for cleaning messy CSV files with 1,200 GitHub stars and 15 outside contributors (example.com/sampatel/tidycsv).
cover_letter.close: I would like to hear how your team splits on-call across the payments services.

gaps: Kubernetes is a plus; Sam has not used it.
